描述_EN: lolita fashion emerged during the 1990s as a radical form of street style born out of the japanese taste for hello kitty cuteness. a striking feature of lolita fashion is the extent to which it is influenced by british culture: alice in wonderland, glam rock, the new romantics, gothic, punk and vivienne westwood. although the attitude and aggression of punk and gothic have no place in the world of the lolita, the movement represents a similarly powerful rebellion against the conventions of contemporary society. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll-like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. whether dressed in pink, powder blue, red, white or black, lolitas are immediately recognisable by their doll- like make-up, frilly skirts, fanciful headgear, ribbons and lace. the first three sections of the display are devoted to sweet, gothic and punk lolita. the final section, japanese lolita, shows how a fascination with the exotic and alternative has resulted in the reappropriation and sometimes extreme recasting of traditional modes of japanese dress.
描述_ZN: 洛丽塔时尚出现在20世纪90年代，是一种激进的街头风格，诞生于日本人对hello kitty可爱的品味。 洛丽塔时尚的一个突出特点是它受英国文化的影响程度：仙境中的爱丽丝、华丽摇滚、新浪漫主义、哥特式、朋克和维维安-韦斯特伍德。 虽然朋克和哥特式的态度和侵略性在洛丽塔的世界中没有地位，但该运动代表了对当代社会惯例的类似的强大反叛。 无论穿着粉红色、粉蓝色、红色、白色还是黑色的衣服，洛丽塔都可以通过她们类似于洋娃娃的妆容、褶皱的裙子、奇特的头饰、丝带和蕾丝而立即被识别。 无论身着粉色、粉蓝色、红色、白色或黑色，洛丽塔都可以通过他们的娃娃式化妆、褶皱的裙子、幻想的头饰、丝带和蕾丝立即被识别。 展览的前三个部分致力于展示甜美、哥特式和朋克式洛丽塔。 最后一部分，日本洛丽塔，展示了对异国情调和另类的迷恋是如何导致了对日本传统服饰模式的再利用和有时的极端重塑。
